# FactoryOps360 Frontend Instructions

- Use Vite + React 18 + TypeScript.
- Keep all API traffic behind `http://localhost:8080`.
- Preserve role-based navigation and route guards.
- Prefer reusable, API-driven UI components over hardcoded data.
- Keep the UI dense, industrial, and responsive for manufacturing operations.
- Use the established `src/` structure for app, api, components, hooks, routes, types, and utils.
